up: Find all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3886617. A compound is considered reported in a document if there is a record in compound_records linking the compound (via molregno) to that document (via doc_id). The document can be identified by its chembl_id in the docs table. Return the molecule ChEMBL ID (chembl_id) and preferred name (pref_name) for each such compound. Use INNER JOINs between compound_records and molecule_dictionary, and between compound_records and docs. Ensure the results are distinct.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM compound_records cr INNER JOIN docs d ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3886617';
